# Function: database()

```ts
function database<TSchema>(config: IDatabaseConfig<TSchema>): {
  config: IDatabaseConfig<TSchema>;
  name: "database";
  plugin: PluginConstructor<BasePluginConfig, DatabasePlugin<TSchema>>;
};

```
